# Backspace Fork 1.16.4

Juno fits the call mosaic properly, gains direct JUNO calls and animated feedback,
and lets the host fill empty seats with built-in computer opponents.

## Fixes and improvements

- Centered real avatars inside their circular aura and player plate, including
  initials and compact/scaled layouts.
- Height- and width-aware lobby, game and results: no vertical table scrolling in
  the validated mosaic sizes. Short views reflow seats, cards and controls rather
  than clipping them; very short calls compact/hide only the visual member strip.
  Large hands scroll horizontally. Rules and rankings have bounded local scrolling.
- Clear active-player glow, next-player marker and turn timer replace repetitive
  instructions and empty-seat text. Narrow headers use accessible icon controls.
- Press the **JUNO logo button** with two cards before playing down to one. The
  host server confirms the call immediately without extending the turn timer;
  drawing clears it. The existing two-card missed-call penalty still applies.
- Confirmed calls send a JUNO logo burst from the announcing player. Played/drawn
  cards, special cards and victory also have short visual effects. Refreshes do
  not replay moves, effects never intercept input, and reduced motion is respected.
  This is visual feedback, not microphone capture or synthesized voice.
- In the lobby, the host can click an empty **+** seat to add a computer opponent,
  or remove one before starting. Up to four total players, including one human
  with up to three computers. Computers use the same authoritative rules and
  only their own cards/public information, with paced server-side turns.
- **Computer games are practice:** no XP, wins or ranked-round counters for
  anyone. Human-only space progression is unchanged. Computers are ephemeral
  game participants, not accounts, memberships or voice connections.
- Updated controls/rules in all five languages; keyboard color selection,
  Escape/focus restoration and origin-aware real profiles remain supported.

## Operations and compatibility

- No new database migration, dependency or S2S/WS event relative to **1.16.3**.
  Older installations still apply any existing pending migrations normally; back
  up the database and uploads before upgrading.
- New optional host capabilities gate computer seats/direct announcements. On
  older hosts, computer management is hidden and the JUNO button retains the
  existing play-time announcement behavior.
- Active tables remain ephemeral across server restart; committed human XP is
  durable. Publishing this release does not itself restart a self-hosted instance.
- Validation includes real HTTP/WebSocket computer management/turns and ranking
  isolation, complete practice rounds, SQLite no-write checks, full isolated test
  suites and controlled real-mosaic visual checks. Actual multi-device LiveKit
  media, native fullscreen Escape, Safari and Firefox were not validated.
